references.text: Eshtemoa is mentioned as one of the Levitical cities given to the descendants of Aaron, the priests, from the tribe of Judah.
Eshtemoa is mentioned as one of the towns in Judah where David sent spoils after defeating the Amalekites.
Eshtemoa with its pasturelands is mentioned as one of the cities given to the descendants of Aaron.
Anab is mentioned as one of the towns in the hill country where Joshua destroyed the Anakim.
